text:
oliver: Post-deploy checks for release (router v2.3.0 -> eu1). Starting full synthetic sweep + targeted embed-route coverage. Rolling window: 10m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 6/6 hosts in eu1. Canary window passed. Smoke probes started. :white_check_mark:

sophia: Seeing mini-synth failing for /v1/embeddings on eu1-edge-03 — intermittent 503s. Anyone picking this up?

miguel: on it, pulling logs now. If it's tokenizer-related the embed path regressed after the tokenizer tweak in v2.3.

synth-bot: probe results: 12/14 probes OK. Failing probes: embed-route-eu1, generation-route-longcontext. p95 latency spike on generation-route -> 1.3s.

oliver: Good breakdown. Which routes lack synthetic coverage? we should avoid blind spots during rollouts.

anya: I checked the sweep config: /internal/rerank and /v1/shortchat have no golden prompts in the suite. Adding quick golden prompts now, but we need acceptance tests to catch semantic regressions.

miguel: Logs show 503s with `KVCache timeout` and router backpressure traces. Running: `kubectl -n inference logs router-eu1-edge-03 --since=5m | grep KVCache` to confirm host-level behavior.

sophia: To be cautious — recommend pinning embed route to v2.2 on eu1 until stabilized. Pin command: `/release pin eu1 embed v2.2` — ops can execute. :lock:

release-ops: @sophia pinned embed route to v2.2 in eu1 (txn 7854). Canary remains on v2.3 for other routes.

oliver: Thanks. Enabling extra telemetry for 15m to watch 5xx rate + p95. NRQL example: `SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'router-eu1' AND response.status = '5xx' TIMESERIES`

synth-bot: Re-ran probes after pin: 13/14 OK. Embed route p95 back to ~480ms. Only generation longcontext still flaky.

miguel: For longcontext, I see memory pressure on a subset of quant hosts. I'll cordon that host and request an autoscaler bump: `scale set --pool eu1-quant --replicas 8`.

anya: Created follow-up ticket INF-4492, assigned to miguel + infra. Added short post-deploy checklist and postmortem template.

oliver: Handoff to eng-sre for monitoring guardrails. @miguel please watch next 30m and post final verdict. If generation p95 doesn't fall <700ms we should rollback router to v2.2 entirely.

miguel: ACK, watching now. +1 to rollback threshold.

sophia: I'll update release notes: mention embed pin, affected routes, golden prompt sets used, and the rollback threshold for transparency.

release-ops: Final status at 3254322005 — embed pinned, probes 13/14 OK, generation-route under investigation. No rollback required at this time. Handoff closed. :handshake:
